The Method × Level Matrix — UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, VT, ET

UT (Ultrasonic Testing) per ASME B&PV Section V Article 4 + ISO 17640 — Level I 40 hours classroom + 210 hours experience, Level II 40 hours + 630 cumulative, Level III procedure authorship. PAUT per ASME Section V Article 4 Mandatory Appendix VIII + ASTM E2491 — Level II minimum 80 hours classroom + 640 hours experience with focal-law authorship and S-scan / E-scan / C-scan acquisition + sizing. TOFD per Appendix III + ISO 10863 — Level II PCS spacing + A-scan/D-scan interpretation. RT per Article 2 + ISO 17636-1 (film) + ISO 17636-2 (digital, DICONDE per ASTM E2339) — Level II 40 hours + 320 hours experience, film density + IQI sensitivity + geometric unsharpness. MT per Article 7 + ASTM E1444 + ISO 17638 — 32 hours classroom + 70 hours experience Level I, AC/DC yoke + wet/dry technique. PT per Article 6 + ASTM E1417 + ISO 3452-1 — 24 hours classroom. VT per Article 9 + EN 13018 + ISO 17637 — 24 hours. ET per Article 8 + ASME Section XI Appendix IV — 40 hours Level I + tube ECT specialisation. Atlantis Academy delivers all eight methods across all three levels with 96% first-pass + free retake-grade backstop.

Certification Pathways — SNT-TC-1A 2024, CP-189-2020, ACCP, ISO 9712:2022, PCN

SNT-TC-1A 2024 — employer-based qualification per §6.3, certificate held by employer, accepted by Aramco / ADNOC / Shell / ExxonMobil for routine inspection. CP-189-2020 — third-party central certification via ASNT, certificate portable, required by ExxonMobil GP 18-10-01 §3.4.2 + Marathon MP-ITP-0042 §5.1 for critical service. ACCP Rev 9 — Professional Level III, ASNT field-experience verified, accepted by Boeing D6-51991 §B.4.3 for composite. ISO 9712:2022 — third-party central, EU PED 2014/68/EU mandate, EN 17643 alignment, Equinor NORSOK M-101 acceptance. PCN — BINDT UK third-party, BP North Sea + Shell UK + Equinor + EDF Heysham acceptance. Atlantis Academy issues all five pathways with bridging exams between schemes. See ASNT certification, ASNT vs PCN.

The API Inspector Stack — API 510, API 570, API 653 on Top of ASNT

The API inspector certifications stack on top of ASNT method certs: API 510 (pressure vessel inspector) per API 510 11th Edition 2024 + ASME Section VIII Div 1; API 570 (piping inspector) per API 570 4th Edition 2024 + ASME B31.3; API 653 (above-ground storage tank inspector) per API 653 5th Edition 2024 + API 650; with API RP 571 damage-mechanism atlas + API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 FFS + API 580/581 RBI as supporting bodies of knowledge. See API 510, API 570, API 653.

The Practical-Week Architecture — What Atlantis Does Differently in the Lab

The practical week separates working inspectors from certificate-holders. Atlantis practical labs run live UT calibration on Olympus Epoch 650 + Sonatest D70 + GE USM Vision + against IIW V1 per ISO 2400 + V2 per ISO 7963 + step wedge + DSC blocks; PAUT scan-plan authoring on Olympus OmniScan X3 + Eddyfi Mantis + Zetec Topaz with wedge-angle + focal-law + encoder calibration per ASME Section V Article 4 Mandatory Appendix VIII + ASTM E2491; TOFD A-scan + D-scan acquisition with PCS spacing per Appendix III + ISO 10863 on representative carbon-steel + 304L + duplex 2205 weld mock-ups; RT film density + IQI sensitivity + geometric unsharpness verification per ISO 17636-1 + DICONDE digital per ISO 17636-2; MT WFMT under UV-A ≥1000 µW/cm² per ASTM E709 + dry-powder yoke per ASTM E1444; PT solvent-removable + post-emulsifiable per ASTM E1417; ET tube-bundle ECT on EDM-notched reference per ASME Section XI Appendix IV. Practical-week pass/fail rides on calibration repeatability and acceptance-criteria recall under examiner stress — Atlantis Academy runs three timed dry-runs before the live examiner sits.
